title: Electricity and magnetism and lab preparation
purpose: Relate fields, potentials and circuits to charge and current, and interpret electromagnetic induction.

blocks.deliverable: Choose symmetry correctly and check dimensions.
Relate a potential difference to a field integral.
Solve a resistor network and check energy balance.
Week 7 midterm; compare field calculations using symmetry.
Track signs with an explicit orientation convention.
Compare RC time constants and derive a simple wave relation.
Document real or simulated data and solve the final examination.

project: Analyze a low voltage RC circuit using safe measurements or a clearly labeled simulation.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
